mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points within a month signals an improving labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over three months signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to increased prices and reduced corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 2% over three months signals inflationary pressure, which can lead to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of real GDP (GDPC1) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates strong economic activity, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where GDPC1 is above its 12-month moving average, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
